description: In OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html), you will see the OrientDB home page showing the list of existing databases. Create a new database named 'LibraryDB' using the 'New Database' button on the home/server page. Set the storage type to 'plocal'. Use the server credentials (username: root, password: GymAnything123!) when prompted. After creating the database, verify it appears in the database list.
